notes: *every* joins גֶּבֶר under rule 15's supplied-determiner sentence, no article, אֶחָד or other determiner morpheme standing in the phrase to license it; the unit is discontinuous around the adjective (rule 25).
שֹׁמֵעַ is an articleless attributive recast as a relative clause and keeps the supplied *that* with itself (rule 41); the second לְ is unrepresented before a bare English object (rule 40).
